provenance: Independent literal inputs and manually specified semantic flags. Author script imports no production module and invokes no subject. Expected responses are never regenerated by tests.

scenarios.description: Same local R1 in two Task identities; all related TR and every System parent, genuine public setup and SQL persistence.
Canonical F4: valid positive[R1] then positive[R2], exact partial and final parents.
Valid matching positive list handles every declared key, not only its first item.
Negative and cancelled are saved proper facts with empty keys; A proof remains, B and parents remain incomplete.
Outer replay and same fact retain one contribution; conflicting ID and unknown snapshot leave every DB row/revision unchanged.
Current same-key changed statement is incomplete before/after publication until matching proof; old context and B preserved.
Alternative facts/old replays cannot overwrite an existing decision, including explicit null; matching explicit choice succeeds and history persists.
Added current empty-child AR blocks its System parent, preserving the other System and frozen contexts.
Compatible independent lower graph: OLD loses its last AR; NEW gains OLD plus an unfulfilled AR. Both old/new Systems recalculated.
Retired former parent has false current applicability/satisfaction, with its original graph/proof retained.
Current TR lower move empties old AR and changes both different System parents; B and all historical publications/facts/choices remain intact.
Current empty sets are applicable but unsatisfied; future placeholder/obsolete are inapplicable, never vacuous success.
Repeated publication retains exact pair/payload; outer replay never rewrites it, and live display values do not mutate frozen history or imply an automatic proof revocation.
Exact declared key/kind/Task/fact admission rejects without any DB change; stored matching positive selection changes the proof, so reject-all cannot pass.
A stored positive for R1 cannot prove a different existing R2, while a stored matching R2 alternative is selectable.
Matching Task/key is insufficient across publication revisions; valid current exact positive selection succeeds, historical context stays unchanged.
First explicit null is a real decision; first later positive stays stored/unselected until a matching explicit positive choice. Other Task untouched.
